UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private authenticated user profile storing owner identity and basic account metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

AnalysisRule.title: AnalysisRule
AnalysisRule.description: User-defined legal clause and risk detection rule stored in Google Firestore.

keywords.description: Phrases or keywords matched by the rule engine.

ContractRecord.title: ContractRecord
ContractRecord.description: Analyzed contract record stored in the Google Firestore Digital Contract Archive with summary, risks, contradictions, authenticity indicators, lock status, and OCR text.

id.description: Unique document ID matching the Firestore document key.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this archived contract.

category.description: US Health Insurance plan classification or legacy contract category.

isContract.description: Whether the uploaded document was identified as a health insurance policy or binding contract.

confidenceNote.description: Explanation of why the document was or was not classified as a policy/contract.

versionGroupId.description: Shared identifier grouping older and newer versions of the same policy.

versionNumber.description: Sequential version number within the version group.

sourceFileName.description: Original uploaded file name or scan label.

sourceMimeType.description: MIME type of the analyzed source file.

extractedText.description: OCR / extracted plain text of the policy.

parties.description: Detected insurer, employer/plan sponsor, and policyholder entities.

keyDates.description: Effective date, expiration date, renewal notice deadline, and duration.

summary.description: Structured plain-language summary of coverage, premiums/cost-share, and exclusions.

clauses.description: Detected policy clauses with section numbers, titles, and plain summaries.

risks.description: Exclusions, prior auth barriers, surprise billing risks, and one-sided conditions.

contradictions.description: Cross-section inconsistencies and conflicting policy clauses.

missingSections.description: Missing or incomplete standard policy disclosures and ACA protections.

legalTerminology.description: Recognized US health insurance and legal terms with plain-English definitions.

authenticity.description: Document completeness indicators and official insurer/entity registry lookup status.

healthAnalysis.description: US Health Insurance affordability, medical history eligibility, coverage history matrix, and TF-IDF + Multinomial Naive Bayes clause sentiment analysis.

notes.description: User annotations on the archived policy.

locked.description: Whether this policy record is locked against edits in Firestore.

lockedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the record was locked in, or empty string.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile documents isolating user email and account metadata.

/analysisRules/{ruleId}.description: Owner-scoped custom legal risk and clause rules stored in Google Firestore.

/contracts/{contractId}.description: Owner-scoped digital contract archive storing analyzed contracts, summaries, risks, contradictions, authenticity indicators, lock status, and version metadata.
